schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The wire shape of codemother's `inspect` verb, and the client that asks it. wire_encode turns a judge's arguments or return value into a form the bus can carry, and wire_decode rebuilds it. A Path crosses as {root: cairn|CairnCommons, rel: <posix>}, the root it sits under and where under it (ticket e215f7524659), and is rebuilt under the ANSWERER's roots; a path under neither root crosses by the host lane {root: abs, host: <gethostname>, v: <absolute posix>}, rebuilds equal on the host that encoded it and raises, naming the path and both hosts, when decoded on another; a path carrying '..' is refused at encode, an unknown root or an escaping rel at decode, and the rel is split on both / and \ so a Windows caller's spelling decodes on Linux. A Workflow crosses as its workflow string and is parsed with parse_workflow on arrival. A Ticket crosses as its id. A frozenset and a tuple cross as lists. Anything else that is not JSON is refused by its type name. ask(judge, *args, **kwargs) requests `inspect` of a real CodeMother process on a scratch bus and returns the decoded answer, which equals the direct call's JSON-normal form (json.loads(json.dumps(x, default=str))); a refusal raises InspectRefused carrying the judge, the reason, and the raised type when the judge itself raised. launch(berths=, tickets_root=, crossing_roots=) is a context that starts that CodeMother through the cairn device's scratch_bus.launch, by name, with the inspector's roots named by her launch environment (CAIRN_BUILD_INSPECTOR_CHART_BERTHS, _TICKETS_ROOT, _CROSSING_ROOTS); every ask inside the block rides it. Outside any block the first ask launches one plain world for the process, closed at exit.
why: Measured 2026-11-13: build_inspector's judges take Paths, Workflows, tickets and frozensets, and the bus carries JSON. Code outside codemother (transitions.py, hollow, outside proofs) asks those judges over the bus once build_inspector moves inside her (ticket 4c4addb09adb). The caller encodes the arguments and codemother decodes them, so one module holds both directions or the two sides drift. Ticket 0c2c3f53c2be made it a plain tool: as codemother's published tool its ask held her shim in the asking process and its fixture wrote her inspector's globals, so an outside proof reached into her twice. Now she is a separate process, launched by name, and her roots are set by her environment, which the inspector honours only under a scratch HOME (ticket d2ecdb867bc9).

invoke: from cairn.tools.inspect_wire.inspect_wire import wire_encode, wire_decode, ask, launch, InspectRefused. Prove: bin/cairn test cairn/tools/inspect_wire/proofs/test_ask_reaches_a_launched_codemother.py and cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_answers_inspect_over_the_bus.py
state_and_history: A TOOL HOLDS NO STATE OF ITS OWN (Law 6). Its voyages ride history.json and state.json beside this charter, born at this address's first crossing.
proof: cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_answers_inspect_over_the_bus.py: tooth 3 sends a Workflow, a Path, a Ticket, a frozenset and a Workflow with no objects through this codec and a spy judge on codemother's side receives each rebuilt equal; tooth 1 compares every allow-listed judge's decoded reply to the direct call. cairn/tools/inspect_wire/proofs/test_ask_reaches_a_launched_codemother.py proves ask and launch, one tooth per clause of 7ea59855b1f4 and 0c2c3f53c2be. cairn/tools/inspect_wire/proofs/test_a_path_crosses_the_wire_by_root.py proves the path form, one tooth per clause of e215f7524659.
gates: Seal: the tester seals the proofs into this tool's validations/.
falsifier: Red if a Workflow, a Path or a Ticket does not rebuild equal to what was sent, or a value with no wire form is coerced instead of refused. Red too if ask answers other than the direct call's JSON-normal form, answers a refusal instead of raising, holds CodeMother in the asking process, or mints a second default bus in one process; or if a launch world's roots are not the ones named, or its bus answers after the block. Red too if a Path crosses as the asking box's absolute string, or an off-root path decoded on another host is answered instead of refused, or one decoded on the same host does not rebuild equal.
how_it_learns: It does not; it is a codec, and a new argument type a judge takes is a new kind added here by a ticket.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation — a device's public interface is the bus plus any client tool it publishes)
Law 7 (a value with no wire form is refused by name, never coerced)
Law 1 (one module holds both directions, so the caller and the answerer cannot disagree)
owner: None of its own: a tool has users (Law 6), code outside codemother that asks `inspect`, and codemother's own verb, which decodes with it. CC gates writes to its code and proofs.
